integrity: The exact rational branch identities and a standalone standard-library checker are provided. Finite exhaustive tests corroborate, but do not substitute for, the infinite proof. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The proven classification is for the fixed lower index five and powers of two; it does not settle odd primes, general lower indices, or historical priority in literature not inspected. The least-period statement is already available in OEIS A349593/A385557; originality is limited to the complete fiber and Haar-density classification.
title: Exact three-level 2-adic fibers of the fifth binomial column
